annotation.title_clean: Women, ethics, robots, AI and data (WERAID) – How can we build the politics of love as we create new technologies?
annotation.title_en: Women, ethics, robots, AI and data (WERAID) – How can we build the politics of love as we create new technologies?
annotation.venue: ICRES 2022: 7th International Conference on Robot Ethics and Standards, Seoul
annotation.summary_en: Conference talk abstract by Richardson introducing 'representational technologies of the human' (sex robots, relational and therapeutic robots and AI). It asks what their design reveals about conceptions of women, men and children, and whether values of love, empathy and attachment should shape technology.
key_provisions_or_claims: Introduces 'representational technologies of the human' (RTH) as a mimesis-inspired concept.
Asks what RTH design reveals about how women, men and children are conceived.
Questions whether relational, sexual and therapeutic roles should be delegated to machines.
Calls for new ideas about technology informed by love, empathy and attachment.
